text.p: SAirGroup said the operating result of its new SAirLines division was "less than satisfactory" in 1996, but it gave no figures.

SAirLines includes the flight operations of the Swissair airline, Crossair AG, Balair/CTA and the cooperation activities with the group's partner airlines, such as Sabena SA and Austrian Airlines AUA.
SAirGroup said in a statement that the introduction of a new timetable concept generated substantial traffic growth and greater market presence for the Swissair brand.

"Various measures were also introduced to enhance bottom-line results; but even these were unable to fully offset the effects of still falling fare levels and a steep rise in the cost of fuel," SAirGroup said.
